svg.title: Dendro evidence-driven RPM architecture
svg.desc: A seven-layer architecture diagram showing Dendro's PyQt6 interface, RPM and OSTree metadata sources, declarative ecosystem registry, classification engine, asynchronous workers and SQLite cache, the separate Flatpak scope, host-environment capability guardrails including composefs bootc, and Fedora host boundaries.

g.text: Manifest-first classification, host-environment guardrails, typed DNF5 authority, and a separate Flatpak scope
host-mode banner and local RPM inspector
Plan review, key trust, offline staging;
uses constrained policy only for opaque RPMs
manifest evidence wins over package policy
one vocabulary for UI and classifier
Taxonomy coverage audit — separate read-only feedback loop
Streams installed-RPM or JSONL repository records, reports category coverage and unresolved capability/path/name clusters, and never creates automatic assignments.
4B. FLATPAK APPS & RUNTIMES — SEPARATE SCOPE, MUTABLE & IMMUTABLE HOST INSTALLS
Read-only list of apps and runtimes;
each update, not exit code alone
Update or uninstall your own apps;
runtimes go with an app only when
speed and time left; Cancel stops
Host boundary: /usr/bin/flatpak runs as your user with a fixed argument list, no shell, a clean environment, and no flatpak-spawn --host.
Active on mutable Fedora, Fedora Atomic, composefs bootc, and read-only /usr hosts; unavailable inside Flatpak. Runtime-only ops disabled.
4C. HOST ENVIRONMENT & CAPABILITY GUARDRAILS — ORDERED KERNEL / VFS PRECEDENCE
Defense-in-depth across UI, workers, Dnf5DaemonClient, operation_gate, and standalone dendro-repo-helper.
mountinfo & /sysroot/composefs run before statvfs('/usr'); env vars and os-release never unlock privileged gates.
5. FEDORA HOST BOUNDARIES — READ-ONLY INSPECTION & TYPED TRANSACTION AUTHORITY
Fedora host ground truth — intentionally unavailable to Flatpak (--system-talk-name=org.rpm.dnf.v0 only)

svg.text: Dendro Architecture Blueprint • GPL-3.0-or-later • Evidence-first classification and kernel-verified host boundaries
